subject: Private VPC interface proofing and ops agenda
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@helixcloud.com>, eng@helixcloud.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC interface proofing and ops agenda

Alice / Helix infra team —

Thanks again for taking time this week. Attached is a short interface matrix (redwood-vpc-interface-matrix-v1.pdf) and a very small test-plan CSV mapping we want to run during the preflight window (mtu-snat-bfd-test-plan.csv). High level asks for the workshop on Friday: 

- Validate IP ranges & expected SNAT behavior for tenant egress (we observed differing SNAT behavior in the lab at /24 vs aggregated /22 ranges)
- Confirm path MTU handling across your edge routers (we saw MTU blackhole on jumbo -> 1500 transitions in the PoC)
- Walk the control-plane endpoint authentication (mTLS cert chain + pinning) and how we expect cert rotation to propagate
- Run the small BFD / keepalive scenario in test plan and capture results into the Drive doc

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick topology recap (5m)
2) IP and SNAT contract (10m)
3) MTU & fragmentation observations (5m)
4) Test-plan handoff & next steps (10m)

If you can confirm the above and upload any infra ACLs or NAT rules we should be aware of, that will make the run much smoother.

Thanks — Irena and Kim are looping in ops/observability questions.

Jonas Weber
Staff PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-vpc-interface-matrix-v1.pdf (application/pdf), mtu-snat-bfd-test-plan.csv (text/csv)

From: Alice Park <alice@helixcloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, eng@helixcloud.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC interface proofing and ops agenda

Jonas — thanks for the clear doc and agenda. A few quick notes after a first pass: 

- IP ranges: we provisioned the proposal subnets as /20 for customer-facing egress, but the fronting router will SNAT to a /24 pool per AZ for legacy logging. That SNAT bucketing is configurable but tied to our legacy L4 balancer.
- MTU: our edge fabric supports 9000 but the transit network truncates to 1500 for certain colo partners. We can instrument and provide pcap during the run; agree we should validate fragmentation fallback.
- mTLS: we use a short-lived certs model with a central CA and an ops sync that pushes certs via signed manifests; rotation window is typically 2 hours from CA issue to apparent rollout across distributed proxies.
- BFD: we can run the BFD keepalive scenario; see note in the CSV about expected timers.

We can join Friday at 10:00 PT. For the test run, can you confirm which instance group we'll use (staging-inference-2 or staging-inference-3)? staging-inference-3 has the newer CNIs and will surface MTU behavior more reliably.

I'll attach the ACL export and a short NAT sketch to the Drive link by EOD.

—Alice
Alice Park
Network Reliability Lead, HelixCloud

Attachment references: helix-acl-export.json (referenced on Drive), nat-bucket-sketch.png (referenced on Drive)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@helixcloud.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC interface proofing and ops agenda

Alice / team — 

Appreciate the quick clarifications. A couple of ops-focused items we need to lock before the run: 

- Observability hooks: we need an HTTP trace/span annotation on the edge for request id and customer-id so our telemetry can correlate tokens to egress buckets. Can your proxy add a header X-Helix-Trace with a 64-bit id or mirror our X-Request-Id?
- Fallback routing policy: if we detect MTU blackhole for large inference responses we want an automatic fail-to-fragment policy (RFC 1191 style) and an alert to SRE. Is that something your edge proxy can toggle per-customer?
- Test harness: Jonas — we'll use staging-inference-3 as Alice suggested. I built two quick scripts (in the CSV) that will run a streaming large-payload generation and a small batching workload to profile fragmentation behavior. Please confirm whether we should coordinate a simultaneous client-side throttling step to avoid conflating batching with MTU effects.

Action items before Friday: 
1) Alice: push ACL export + NAT sketch to Drive and confirm SNAT bucketing surface (in Drive link).
2) Jonas: confirm test client cadence and booking for staging-inference-3 (I can schedule infra windows).
3) Kimberly: prepare a quick checklist for runbook updates (observability alerts, SLO notes).

Thanks — I can take the client-throttle coordination if you want, Jonas.

Irene Choi
Principal Engineer, Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@helixcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC interface proofing and ops agenda — runbook checklist

Short checklist for Friday's preflight run (finalizing):

- Runbook entries to update:
  * Observability: add trace mapping and token->egress-bucket correlation (owner: telemetry)
  * Alerts: MTU blackhole detection (packet-loss vs PMTU failure signature) (owner: SRE)
  * Rollback: how to switch SNAT mapping back to /22 aggregator if we see increased logging costs (owner: network-ops)
- Test windows: 11:00–11:45 PT (run harness), 11:45–12:00 PT (post-run log collection)
- Contacts: Helix infra (Alice Park), Redwood ops on-call (pager: infra-oncall)
- Evidence to capture: tcpdump + pcap from edge, proxy logs with X-Helix-Trace header, application-level token logs for correlation

Kimberly will own the post-run checklist and the initial runbook patch. Jonas — can you confirm the client cadence (requests/sec and payload distribution) so I can pre-seed alert thresholds? If no response by EOD today I'll assume 50 rps (burst 200) for the large-payload stream and 10 rps for batching tests.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Referenced attachments: redwood-vpc-interface-matrix-v1.pdf, mtu-snat-bfd-test-plan.csv
